context.description: Context describing what is being confirmed (e.g. the action the agent wants to take, or the question it needs answered). Rendered as plain text, not Markdown.

negativeLabel.description: Label for the declining action of a binary confirmation (e.g. "Not yet"). Unset when `questions` is populated.
